summary: Child of Chaos is a versatile limited hero whose passive restricts external energy gain, but his ultimate rotation can still be tuned to 18 seconds through direct Skill Haste gear or the Benevolent talent. His exclusive artifact, Dragonbone Catalyst, provides either a 30% damage boost for matching-element allies or 30% damage reduction for different-element allies. With the Gaze of Chaos talent activated, he ignores enemy resistance, eliminating the requirement for Accuracy stats on gear. Players are strongly encouraged to pull for Child of Chaos while his limited banner is active.

tips: Equip Skill Haste gear (such as Starlight Echo set) or select the Benevolent talent to lower Child of Chaos's ultimate skill rotation to 18 seconds.
Puppeteer's Inspiration set bonus only increases Child of Chaos's ultimate energy if equipped directly on him, not when worn by team allies.
Unlock the Gaze of Chaos talent to ignore enemy resistance, allowing you to skip building Accuracy on Child of Chaos.
Prioritize obtaining Child of Chaos and his exclusive artifact Dragonbone Catalyst during his limited banner period.
